notes: Current Burial Grounds Android development candidate. Restores the camera zoom control as part of the Burial Grounds mobile side UI: plus/minus controls and a draggable vertical zoom bar synchronized with the native camera zoom and pinch zoom. Zoom requests are queued and applied on the engine thread. Includes all prior touch, context-menu, action-strip, UI-scale, renderer-mailbox, duplicate-upload, and updater improvements.
